title: Disentangling Strain and Ti3+ Contributions to the Anomalous Hall Effect in Epitaxial RuO2 Films
summary: The anomalous Hall effect (AHE) reported in epitaxial RuO2/TiO2 has been attributed to a strain-stabilized magnetic state, but strain can be entangled with Ru-Ti intermixing and interfacial charge redistribution, which can produce Ti3+ and potentially localized moments. Here, we disentangle these contributions using Ti-alloyed RuO2 heterostructures in which abundant Ti3+ states are retained while epitaxial strain is independently changed. The strained and relaxed films have nearly identical Ti/Ru compositions and comparable Ti3+ fractions, yet a pronounced nonlinear AHE appears only in the coherently strained film, while the relaxed heterostructure exhibits an almost linear Hall response. Spectroscopic ellipsometry further shows that the AHE-active strained state is accompanied by a reconstruction of the itinerant electronic response, including enhanced metallicity and longer carrier relaxation times. These results show that Ti3+ formation alone is insufficient to generate the anomalous Hall state and identify epitaxial strain, through its modification of the itinerant RuO2 electronic structure, as the dominant control parameter.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过Ti合金化RuO2异质结构解耦应变与Ti3+贡献，证明外延应变（而非Ti3+或界面电荷转移）是产生反常霍尔效应的主导因素。
AI.motivation: RuO2/TiO2中的反常霍尔效应此前归因于应变稳定的磁性态，但应变常与Ru-Ti互混、界面电荷重分布纠缠，后者会产生Ti3+及可能的局域磁矩，因此需要将其贡献分离。
AI.method: 采用Ti合金化的RuO2异质结构，在独立改变外延应变的同时保留大量Ti3+态，对比应变与弛豫薄膜的Hall响应，并用椭偏光谱表征电子结构。
AI.result: 应变与弛豫薄膜的Ti/Ru组成和Ti3+比例几乎相同，但明显的非线性反常霍尔效应仅出现在共格应变薄膜中，弛豫样品呈近线性Hall响应；椭偏光谱显示AHE活跃的应变态伴随金属性增强和载流子弛豫时间延长。
AI.conclusion: Ti3+的形成本身不足以产生反常霍尔态，外延应变通过修正RuO2的巡游电子结构成为主导控制参数。

title: Entropy Estimates from Stochastic Interpolants
summary: We present a general method for estimating entropy differences between arbitrary probability distributions using stochastic interpolants. The marginal distributions which bridge the base and target obey a continuity equation, which allows a straightforward calculation of the entropy difference in terms of an inner product of the probability flow velocity and score fields. This formulation has several advantages: (i) no computationally expensive divergence calculations of either field are required, (ii) the score field need not even be learned directly if model transferability is not required, and (iii) on-the-fly estimates are produced nearly for free during training. When tractable base distributions are chosen (e.g. Gaussian chain, ideal gas, etc.), statistical thermodynamic entropies are then immediately recovered. Notably, the analysis relies only on the definition of the Gibbs-Shannon entropy, rather than any particular statistical mechanical ensemble, so that generalized non-equilibrium entropies may be computed. The method is demonstrated on several systems of increasing complexity: (i) a 40-dimensional Gaussian mixture model, (ii) the classical XY model of N spins arranged in one dimension, (iii) the 13-atom Lennard-Jones cluster, and (iv) an active Brownian polymer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用随机插值（stochastic interpolants）估计任意概率分布间熵差的方法，基于连续性方程将熵差表示为概率流速度与score场的内积，无需散度计算，可在训练中近乎免费地在线估计，并演示于多个复杂系统。
AI.motivation: 现有方法计算熵差通常需要昂贵的散度计算或直接学习score场，效率低且适用性受限；作者希望找到一种仅依赖Gibbs-Shannon熵定义、可用于广义非平衡熵的通用且高效方法。
AI.method: 利用随机插值构造连接基分布与目标分布的边际分布，其满足连续性方程；据此将熵差写成概率流速度与score场的内积。该方法不需要对两个场做散度计算，若不需要模型迁移性甚至无需直接学习score场，并能在训练过程中近乎免费地得到在线估计。选择可处理的基分布（如高斯链、理想气体）时可直接恢复统计热力学熵。
AI.result: 在四个复杂度递增的系统上验证：(i) 40维高斯混合模型，(ii) 一维N自旋经典XY模型，(iii) 13原子Lennard-Jones团簇，(iv) 活性布朗聚合物。
AI.conclusion: 该方法仅依赖Gibbs-Shannon熵定义而非特定统计力学系综，因此可计算广义非平衡熵，是一种通用、高效且应用广泛的熵差估计框架。

title: Moment-informed force rescaling for random-batch Langevin dynamics
summary: Random-batch methods accelerate molecular dynamics by replacing full interaction sums with stochastic force estimators. In Langevin simulations, however, random-batch force errors can cause artificial heating and distort equilibrium and dynamical observables, especially for small batch sizes or under weak thermostat coupling. Moreover, the magnitude of these errors can vary across particles. We introduce moment-informed force rescaling for random-batch list (Mi-RBL) and random-batch Ewald (Mi-RBE) methods. A lagged average of each particle's sampled-force intensity sets an isotropic gain before the current batch is sampled, changing the random-batch force magnitude without changing its direction. The formal finite-time analysis quantifies the bias--variance tradeoff, and an estimate of the steady-state kinetic-temperature error predicts the scaling of the kinetic error with time step and thermostat friction. In the coexistence, binary-mixture, and electrolyte tests, Mi-RBL and Mi-RBE reduce kinetic errors and more closely reproduce the mean-square displacement, radial distribution function, and charge density profiles of the reference solutions. Mi-RBE also reduces the growth rate of the kinetic error with the time step by more than half and retains the predicted dependence on thermostat friction. The tested rescaling strength decreases with increasing batch size, and the particlewise update retains $O(N)$ complexity for fixed batch size.

AI.tldr: 提出矩信息驱动的力重标定方法（Mi-RBL、Mi-RBE），修正随机批次分子动力学中力估计误差导致的伪加热问题。
AI.motivation: 随机批次方法通过随机力估计加速分子动力学，但在Langevin模拟中力误差会引起伪加热，扭曲平衡与动力学观测量，尤其在大批次尺寸或弱恒温器耦合下，且误差大小因粒子而异。
AI.method: 用每个粒子采样力强度的滞后平均值，在当前批次采样前设定各向同性增益，只改变随机批次力的大小而不改变方向；并通过有限时间分析量化偏差-方差权衡，给出稳态动能温度误差估计。
AI.result: 在共存、二元混合物与电解质测试中，Mi-RBL/Mi-RBE降低动能误差，更准确地重现参考的均方位移、径向分布函数与电荷密度分布；Mi-RBE将动能误差随时步增长率降低一半以上，并保持对恒温器摩擦的预测依赖；重标定强度随批次增大而减小，粒子级更新保持O(N)复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 力矩信息重标定能在不改变力方向、保持计算复杂度的前提下有效抑制随机批次分子动力学的伪加热，提高模拟精度。

title: Spinon-Induced Phonon Dynamics in Chiral and $π$-Flux Quantum Spin Liquids
summary: Quantum spin liquids (QSLs) are magnetic phases that evade long-range order down to the lowest temperatures due to strong quantum fluctuations. Their lack of conventional order parameters, however, makes experimental identification challenging. In this work, we investigate how distinct QSL phases affect phonon dynamics through spinon-phonon coupling. By computing the phonon self-energy, we show that the phonon spectrum remains unrenormalized by spinon interactions, while sound attenuation and phonon thermal conductivity exhibit distinct signatures of the underlying QSL phase. These response functions therefore provide experimentally accessible fingerprints for distinguishing different QSL backgrounds. Remarkably, we find that a chiral QSL coupled to phonons does not generate a phonon thermal Hall effect despite explicitly breaking time-reversal symmetry. Our results establish phonon transport as a potential probe for identifying and characterizing quantum spin liquids.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究量子自旋液体（QSL）通过自旋子-声子耦合对声子动力学的影响，发现声子谱不被重整化，但声衰减和声子热导率能提供区分不同QSL相的指纹，且手性QSL不产生声子热霍尔效应。
AI.motivation: 量子自旋液体因强量子涨落缺乏长程有序，没有常规序参量，导致实验识别极为困难，因此需要寻找可实验探测的指纹来区分不同QSL相。
AI.method: 通过计算声子自能，研究不同QSL相如何经由自旋子-声子耦合影响声子动力学，并分析声衰减、声子热导率等响应函数。
AI.result: 声子谱不被自旋子相互作用重整化；声衰减和声子热导率展现出区分不同QSL相的显著特征；与声子耦合的手性QSL尽管显式破坏时间反演对称性，却不产生声子热霍尔效应。
AI.conclusion: 声子输运可作为识别和表征量子自旋液体的潜在探针。

title: Altermagnetic Magnons in Dipolar Nanomagnet Arrays
comment: main: 9 pages, 4 figures; supplement: 7 pages, 2 figures
summary: Altermagnetism is conventionally understood in a spin-conserving framework, where symmetry-enforced momentum-dependent spin splitting emerges in collinear magnets with vanishing net magnetization. Here, we show that its defining signatures persist in nanomagnet arrays coupled exclusively by dipolar interactions, despite the intrinsic breaking of spin conservation. Using a macrospin theory of dipolar-coupled ferromagnetic nanoislands, corroborated by micromagnetic simulations, we demonstrate that arrays engineered with altermagnetic symmetries exhibit spin-split magnon bands whose eigenstates can partially remain strongly spin polarized. The resulting spin expectation value displays the characteristic $d$-wave pattern throughout the Brillouin zone, establishing a mesoscopic realization of altermagnetic magnons beyond the conventional spin-conserving paradigm. As a consequence, spin-wave propagation becomes strongly direction dependent, providing a highly tunable platform for anisotropic magnon transport and synthetic altermagnetic functionality.

AI.tldr: 本文将交替磁性概念扩展到非自旋守恒的偶极耦合纳米磁体阵列，证明其标志性特征仍可保留。
AI.motivation: 传统交替磁性理解基于自旋守恒框架，作者希望探究在自旋守恒被内禀破坏的偶极相互作用体系中，交替磁性特征能否存续。
AI.method: 采用偶极耦合铁磁纳米岛的宏观自旋理论，并结合微磁模拟进行研究。
AI.result: 具有交替磁性对称性的阵列展现出自旋劈裂的磁振子能带，本征态可保持强自旋极化，自旋期望值在整个布里渊区呈现d波图案；自旋波传播具强方向依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 实现了超越自旋守恒范式的介观交替磁性磁振子，为各向异性磁振子输运与合成交替磁性功能提供高度可调平台。

title: Logarithmic singularity in a dynamical quantum phase transition for free fermions
summary: We study the Loschmidt echo in a system of N non-interacting spinless lattice fermions released from a double-domain-wall initial state. In the large-N limit, the return probability is characterized by a large-deviation rate function known as the dynamical free energy. The Loschmidt echo is dominated by a complex instanton configuration, and the dynamical free energy develops a logarithmic singularity at the dynamical quantum phase transition. We obtain analytical results in the short-time and long-time regimes and support them with numerical computations. We show that the transition can be understood as a topological change of the dominant instanton configuration, analogous to the emergence of a cut in random matrix theory. We further show that post-selection can drive the system through two successive DQPTs, associated with successive topological changes of the dominant instanton configuration in complex time.

AI.tldr: 研究从双畴壁初始态释放的N个无相互作用无自旋格点费米子的Loschmidt echo，在N很大时用大偏差率函数（动力学自由能）刻画回返概率，并揭示该动力学量子相变(DQPT)源于复时间主导瞬子构型的拓扑变化。
AI.motivation: 探究Loschmidt echo与动力学量子相变的内在机制，特别是瞬子构型在复时间中的角色，并寻找与随机矩阵理论中割线出现的类比。
AI.method: 以双畴壁初始态释放的N个自由格点费米子为模型，取大N极限，得到由复瞬子主导的动力学自由能；给出短时与长时渐近解析结果，并配合数值计算验证；同时引入后选择(post-selection)操作。
AI.result: 动力学自由能在DQPT处出现对数奇异性；主导瞬子构型发生拓扑变化，类似随机矩阵中割线的出现；短时与长时解析结果与数值一致；后选择可驱动系统经历两次相继的DQPT，对应复时间中瞬子构型的连续拓扑改变。
AI.conclusion: DQPT可被理解为复时间主导瞬子构型的拓扑转变，且通过后选择可实现多次相继相变，深化了对Loschmidt echo非平衡动力学的理解。

title: Braided endovascular implants for intracranial aneurysms: mechanics, hemodynamics, and clinical translation
summary: Endovascular implants prevent intracranial aneurysm rupture by altering the mechanical and hemodynamic environment at the aneurysm neck. Yet many in silico workflows prescribe or reconstruct the post-deployment geometry before computing flow, leaving unresolved the mechanics that create the clinically relevant interface. Here we review braided intraluminal flow diverters, intrasaccular devices, and emerging flow-disruption concepts across deployment mechanics, inter-wire and wire-wall contact, superelasticity, wall apposition, pore geometry, computational fluid dynamics, and fluid-structure interaction. We connect these modeling choices to neck coverage, malapposition, migration, deformation, and durability, and distinguish established evidence from mechanistic inference and prospective hypotheses. We argue that model fidelity should match the clinical question: prescribed or fast placement may support screening, whereas questions of coverage, apposition, compaction, and migration benefit from mechanically plausible deployment states. An interface-resolved mechanics-to-flow framework, supported by measurable validation targets and standardized reporting, could improve device design and enable more reliable patient-specific treatment planning.

AI.tldr: 综述编织型血流导向装置与囊内装置的部署力学、力学-血流耦合建模，主张发展界面分辨的力学到血流框架以提升器械设计与个体化治疗规划。
AI.motivation: 血管内植入物通过改变动脉瘤颈部的力学与血流动力学环境来防止破裂，但现有计算流程多在计算血流前预先指定或重建部署后几何，未解决形成临床关键界面的力学问题。
AI.method: 综述编织型腔内血流导向装置、囊内装置及新兴血流阻断概念，涵盖部署力学、丝间与丝-壁接触、超弹性、贴壁、孔隙几何、CFD与流固耦合，并将建模选择与颈部覆盖、贴壁不良、迁移、变形和耐久性关联，区分已有证据、机制推断与前瞻假设。
AI.result: 不同建模保真度适用于不同临床问题：预设或快速部署几何可支持筛查，而覆盖、贴壁、压实与迁移问题需要力学上合理的部署状态。
AI.conclusion: 界面分辨的力学到血流框架，配合可测量的验证目标与标准化报告，可改进器械设计并实现更可靠的患者个体化治疗规划。

title: Quantum electrodynamics of equilibrium systems: A rigorous Maxwell-regularized functional-theoretic formulation
summary: A framework for quantum electrodynamics of equilibrium systems is proposed that takes the Maxwell equations as foundational and links them to the structure of density-functional theory for the quantum system. By switching from purely internal observables like the one-particle density to combined internal and external quantities, the external sources and their energy are taken into account. A fully regularized functional theory emerges that avoids the usual representability problems. With the Kohn-Sham construction that links to an auxiliary uncoupled system, the ultra-violet cutoff can be removed and one arrives at a fully renormalized and non-perturbative light-matter description. Regularized forms of density-functional theory with and without magnetic fields appear as boundary cases, while the emergent physical picture reproduces the macroscopic Maxwell equations.

AI.tldr: 提出一个平衡态量子电动力学框架，以麦克斯韦方程为出发点，与密度泛函理论结构相联系，给出完全重整化、非微扰的光-物质描述。
AI.motivation: 传统量子电动力学与密度泛函理论存在可表示性问题，且紫外截断难以去除，需要将内部与外部观测量统一处理，并兼顾外部源及其能量。
AI.method: 以麦克斯韦方程为理论基础，将单粒子密度等纯内部观测量替换为内部与外部相结合的观测量。采用Kohn-Sham构造，关联一个辅助非耦合系统，从而移除紫外截断。
AI.result: 得到完全正则化的泛函理论，避免通常的可表示性问题；移除紫外截断后获得完全重整化且非微扰的光-物质描述；有磁场和无磁场的正则化密度泛函理论成为边界情形；涌现的物理图像可复现宏观麦克斯韦方程。
AI.conclusion: 该框架统一了麦克斯韦方程与密度泛函理论，为平衡态量子电动力学提供了正则化、重整化的非微扰表述，并自然还原宏观电动力学。

title: Fröhlich Bipolarons in Two-Dimensional Materials
summary: Motivated by the progress in the physics of two-dimensional materials and the recent two-dimensional generalization of the Fröhlich model, we study the formation of bipolarons in polar monolayers. Because of very special nonlocal dielectric screening in two dimensions, this setting differs qualitatively from the conventional Fröhlich model. In monolayers, (i) long wavelength LO phonons acquire a nontrivial dispersion; (ii) the Fröhlich electron-phonon vertex becomes momentum-dependent and regular at small momenta; and (iii) direct repulsion between charge carriers takes the Keldysh-Rytova form. Using the Feynman path-integral variational approach, we show that the region in the parameter space where stable bipolarons exist is strongly modified compared to the usual quasi-two-dimensional model with dispersionless phonons. Specifically, in the most favorable limit, when the ratio $σ_0$ of the static polarizability to the high-frequency polarizability tends to infinity, the lower critical coupling, sufficient for the formation of bipolarons, can be made arbitrarily small. More surprisingly, we demonstrate that no stable bipolarons can exist in the strong coupling limit: in the isolated monolayer the stability region is always confined to a finite range of coupling constants. In general, the stability region is strongly shifted toward large values of the polarizability ratio $σ_0$, well beyond the parameter regimes in representative crystals, which indicates that polar monolayers do not favor bipolarons.

AI.tldr: 研究极性单层中双极化子的形成，发现其稳定性区域与常规Fröhlich模型有本质差异，且极性单层不利于双极化子形成。
AI.motivation: 受二维材料物理进展及Fröhlich模型二维推广的启发，探究极性单层中双极化子的形成，因二维非局域介电屏蔽与常规模型本质不同。
AI.method: 采用Feynman路径积分变分方法，考虑LO声子色散、动量依赖的Fröhlich顶点及Keldysh-Rytova形式的直接库仑排斥。
AI.result: 存在稳定双极化子的参数区域较无色散声子模型显著改变。在σ0→∞最优极限下，形成双极化子的下临界耦合可任意小；但在强耦合极限下不存在稳定双极化子，孤立单层中稳定区域始终限于有限耦合范围。总体稳定区域强烈偏向大σ0值，超出典型晶体参数范围。
AI.conclusion: 极性单层不利于双极化子的形成。

title: Exact Nonlinear Active Microrheology in Diffusive Single-File Systems
summary: Active microrheology probes a crowded medium by forcing a tracer and measuring its response. In single-file transport, where particles cannot overtake, a constant force $F$ produces a subballistic displacement $\langle X_t\rangle\simeq \sqrt{t}\,ξ(F)$ together with a persistent bath deformation. Despite decades of work, the exact nonlinear response at arbitrary force has remained confined to a few special solvable models. Here we remove this restriction by combining recent advances in hydrodynamic transport coefficients, a pressure-balance formulation of the local drive, and single-file duality, which eliminates the resulting moving boundary. This yields a closed exact boundary-value problem for general diffusive single files, determining both $ξ(F)$ and the full density profile. For overdamped Brownian particles with general interactions, all microscopic interaction details enter only through the equilibrium equation of state, bringing realistic interacting systems, including finite-width quasi-one-dimensional channels, within exact reach. The solution also reveals universal global laws; in particular, the bath-density dipole is fixed by the applied force independently of the interaction potential.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种通用方法，精确求解任意驱动力下扩散型单列输运的非线性响应，相互作用细节仅通过平衡态状态方程进入，并揭示普适的全局规律。
AI.motivation: 单列输运中恒定力产生次弹道位移与持续浴变形，但任意力下的精确非线性响应长期仅限少数可解模型，亟需突破这一限制。
AI.method: 结合流体输运系数新进展、局部驱动的压力平衡表述与单列对偶性（消除移动边界），得到一个封闭的精确边值问题，求解ξ(F)与完整密度分布。
AI.result: 对具有一般相互作用的过阻尼布朗粒子，微观相互作用细节仅通过平衡态状态方程体现，使真实相互作用系统（含有限宽准一维通道）可精确处理；并发现浴密度偶极子由外力固定、与相互作用势无关的普适规律。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将任意力下单列非线性响应的精确求解推广到一般扩散型系统，建立微观相互作用与宏观响应间的简洁联系并揭示普适全局定律。

title: Load balancing for adaptive-precision interatomic potentials in materials science
summary: For atomistic molecular dynamics simulations, we consider a recently developed hybrid coupling between the highly accurate machine learning (ML)-based atomic cluster expansion (ACE) interaction model and a less precise (but about 1-2 orders faster) EAM potential, in order to leverage the performance bottleneck of pure ML potentials in a parallel computing environment. This spatial-temporal adaptivity has the potential for a speedup of more than an order of magnitude, that would be lost without a dynamic load-balancing strategy that becomes critical due to fluctuating potential contributions. We compare the load-balancing strategies of LAMMPS with load-balancing methods provided by the library ALL in adaptive-precision EAM-ACE simulations of a copper nanoindentation. For a regular-grid domain decomposition, the modified tensor method of the ALL library, which conserves the simplicity and transferability of the tensor method, significantly reduces the imbalance factor of the force calculation from 3.0 to 1.7 compared to the native load-balancing method of LAMMPS. A nearly perfectly balanced system with an imbalance factor close to 1.0 can be reached by load balancing an irregular grid of domains with the recursive bisectioning method of LAMMPS and with ALL's histogram method for a staggered grid of domains. Load balancing a staggered grid with ALL is found to be significantly faster than load balancing an irregular grid with the bisectioning method of LAMMPS, but the communication costs during a regular timestep are lower for the irregular grid of domains, as a lower surface-by-volume ratio of the domains is reached. Furthermore, we suggest a strategy to find the ideal load-balancing frequency for adaptive-precision simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自适应精度EAM-ACE铜纳米压痕模拟中的动态负载均衡策略，比较LAMMPS与ALL库的多种方法，并提出理想负载均衡频率的选取策略。
AI.motivation: 纯机器学习势（如ACE）精度高但速度慢，是并行计算中的性能瓶颈。将ACE与速度快1-2个数量级的EAM势进行时空自适应混合耦合，有望实现一个数量级以上的加速，但势贡献的波动使得动态负载均衡变得至关重要。
AI.method: 在铜纳米压痕的自适应精度EAM-ACE模拟中，对比LAMMPS的负载均衡方法（如本征方法、递归二分法）与ALL库提供的方法（改进张量法、直方图法），分别用于规则网格、不规则网格和交错网格的域分解。
AI.result: 规则网格下，ALL的改进张量法将力计算的不均衡因子从3.0降至1.7；不规则网格（LAMMPS二分法）与交错网格（ALL直方图法）可达到接近1.0的近乎完美均衡。ALL对交错网格的负载均衡速度明显快于LAMMPS二分法，但不规则网格因域表面积-体积比更低，常规时间步通信开销更小。
AI.conclusion: 改进张量法保持了张量法的简洁性与可移植性并显著改善均衡；不同网格/方法在负载均衡速度与通信开销间存在权衡。论文进一步提出了为自适应精度模拟寻找理想负载均衡频率的策略。

title: Direct observation of phonon mode with an antisymmetric Raman tensor
summary: Phonon angular momentum, characterized by circular or elliptical motion of atoms, plays a decisive role in diverse phenomena, ranging from the phonon Hall effect, phonon magnetic moment, Einstein-de Haas effect, Weyl phonons, and driven chiral phonons. The phonon modes with an antisymmetric Raman tensor, which carry an intrinsic phonon angular momentum in a pseudovector symmetry channel, have been overlooked in the past in the chiral phonon community. Here, we report the detection of this type of phonon mode using polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy. We observe a phonon at 266cm$^{-1}$ in the antiferromagnetic chiral phase of Cr$_2$O$_3$ in the $A_2$-pseudovector symmetry channel. This $A_2$ mode's frequency and the elliptical motion are captured by first-principles phonon calculations, which treat both lattice and spins on an equal footing as 'slow' degrees of freedom. This mode gets Raman activity due to the presence of Cr vacancies in Cr$_2$O$_3$ that locally break the twofold rotational symmetry perpendicular to the threefold axis. Our results provide a new way to detect the novel symmetry-forbidden $A_2$ phonon modes with an antisymmetric Raman tensor in a pseudovector symmetry channel.

AI.tldr: 本文通过偏振分辨拉曼光谱在Cr₂O₃反铁磁手性相中探测到266cm⁻¹的A₂膜声子模式，该模式具有反对称拉曼张量并携带本征声子角动量。
AI.motivation: 具有反对称拉曼张量、在赝矢量对称通道中携带本征声子角动量的声子模式此前在手性声子领域被忽视，需要新的探测手段。
AI.method: 采用偏振分辨拉曼光谱探测Cr₂O₃反铁磁手性相中的声子，并结合将晶格与自旋同等对待为"慢"自由度的第一性原理声子计算。
AI.result: 在A₂赝矢量对称通道观察到266cm⁻¹声子，其频率与椭圆运动被计算捕获；该模式因Cr空位破坏三重轴垂直方向的二重旋转对称而获得拉曼活性。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了探测赝矢量对称通道中具有反对称拉曼张量的新型对称禁戒A₂声子模式的新途径。

title: Chiral classical and quantum acoustics with hole-spin qubits
summary: Gate-defined hole spins combine strong spin-orbit coupling with exceptional strain sensitivity, making surface acoustic waves a natural route to remote, phase-coherent control. We show that counterpropagating surface acoustic waves can differ in coupling strength and in whether they predominantly drive spin rotations or modulate the qubit frequency. We call the transverse transition-strength imbalance spin-acoustic chirality and show that it is tunable through gate-controlled reshaping of the dot confinement. Combining a multiband Luttinger-Kohn Hamiltonian with the Bir-Pikus description of strain and 3D piezoelectric finite-element simulations, we obtain the acoustic g-matrix modulation governing coherent SAW driving. Quantizing the same strain-mediated interaction yields the corresponding single-phonon coupling, and a generalized anisotropic Rabi interaction with co-rotating, counter-rotating, and longitudinal components, linking classical chirality to quantum anisotropy and directional one-phonon emission. Magnetic field orientation and dot shape tune the acoustic chirality and operator selectivity. We illustrate this framework through bichromatic coherence protection and phonon-mediated heralded Bell-state initialization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"自旋-声学手性"概念，研究门控空穴自旋与反向传播表面声波的耦合，揭示耦合强度与驱动模式的可调各向异性。
AI.motivation: 门控空穴自旋具有强自旋轨道耦合和应变敏感性，表面声波是实现远程相位相干控制的理想途径，但反向传播声波耦合差异及其调控机制尚未明确。
AI.method: 结合多带Luttinger-Kohn哈密顿量与Bir-Pikus应变描述及三维压电有限元模拟，获取声学g矩阵调制；量化应变介导相互作用得到单声子耦合和广义各向异性Rabi相互作用。
AI.result: 反向传播声波在耦合强度和驱动模式（自旋旋转vs频率调制）上存在差异，即自旋-声学手性；可通过门控调节量子点约束、磁场方向和点形状来调控该手性与算符选择性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将经典手性与量子各向异性、定向单声子发射联系起来，并演示了双色相干保护和声子介导的预示性Bell态初始化。

title: Recent progress on thermal transport in one-dimensional long-range interacting Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou lattice systems
summary: Long-range (LR) interactions are no longer just a theoretical idea: they can be engineered in several low-dimensional platforms and offer a new way to control heat transport. At the same time, they push beyond the standard picture developed mainly for short-range, momentum-conserving lattices. In this review, we consider one-dimensional Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou (FPUT)-type lattices where LR effects enter mainly through a quartic anharmonic coupling that decays as a power law, characterized by an exponent σ. Our goal is to explain, in a unified way, how LR anharmonicity changes microscopic energy exchange, collective dynamics, and the macroscopic scaling laws of heat conduction-while also clarifying what is well established and what is still debated (For more details of the abstract, please see the main text and paper).

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于一维长程FPUT型晶格热输运的综述，强调四阶非谐耦合按幂律衰减（指数σ）如何改变微观能量交换、集体动力学及宏观热传导标度律。
AI.motivation: 长程相互作用不再只是理论构想，已可在多种低维平台中实现，并为调控热输运提供新途径；同时它超出了主要针对短程、动量守恒晶格建立的标准理论框架，需系统性梳理。
AI.method: 综述一维FPUT型晶格，其中长程效应主要通过按幂律衰减的四阶非谐耦合引入，用衰减指数σ刻画，并统一分析微观能量交换、集体动力学与宏观热传导标度律。
AI.result: 以统一方式阐述长程非谐性如何影响微观能量交换、集体动力学和宏观热传导标度律，并厘清哪些结论已确立、哪些仍存争议。
AI.conclusion: 长程非谐性为热传导提供了超越短程标准理论的新机制，但相关标度律与物理图像仍有待进一步明确。

title: LSR-Net: Learning the Forward Evolution Operator for Nonlinear Fluid Dynamics
summary: We introduce the Long-Short-Range Neural Network (LSR-Net), a novel neural operator architecture designed for data-driven forward evolution modeling, and extends it to the prediction of nonlinear fluid dynamics. LSR-Net learns the evolution operator of a dynamical system solely from pairs of initial and future state snapshots, which splits the learnable integral kernel into long-range (LR) and short-range (SR) components within stacked network blocks. While the SR component uses standard convolutions to capture local dynamics, the LR component employs a sum-of-exponentials (SOE) representation. This allows for the efficient computation of global interactions as a trainable Fourier multiplier, reducing computational complexity to $O(n \log n)$ where $n$ is the number of pixels in an input snapshot and requiring only a few parameters per channel. LSR-Net is evaluated on three challenging 2D benchmarks: the coupled Burgers equation, the wave equation with a spatially varying coefficient, and the nonlinear shallow water equation {(SWE)}. Results demonstrate that LSR-Net significantly outperforms the baseline short-range network (SR-Net) as well as FNO and DeepONets in predictive accuracy, achieving substantially lower relative errors by effectively capturing both local fine-scale structures and crucial global pattern interactions.

AI.tldr: LSR-Net 是一种新的神经算子架构，将演化核分解为长程与短程分量，短程用卷积、长程用指数和表示的傅里叶乘子，实现 O(n log n) 复杂度，在多个二维非线性流体基准上优于 SR-Net、FNO 与 DeepONets。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动的前向演化建模需要同时捕捉局部精细结构与全局模式交互，而单一短程网络或已有算子方法在此方面存在局限，因此需要一种兼顾长程与短程的神经算子架构。
AI.method: LSR-Net 仅从初始与未来状态快照对中学习动力学演化算子；在堆叠网络块内将可学习积分核拆分为长程（LR）与短程（SR）两部分：SR 使用标准卷积捕捉局部动力学，LR 使用指数和（SOE）表示，从而以可训练傅里叶乘子高效计算全局交互，复杂度降至 O(n log n)，且每通道仅需少量参数。
AI.result: 在三个具有挑战性的二维基准（耦合 Burgers 方程、空间变系数波动方程、非线性浅水方程 SWE）上，LSR-Net 的预测精度显著优于基线短程网络 SR-Net 以及 FNO 和 DeepONets，相对误差大幅降低。
AI.conclusion: LSR-Net 通过长程-短程分解有效兼顾局部细尺度结构和关键全局模式交互，是一种高效且高精度的非线性流体动力学前向演化预测神经算子。

title: Complex magnetic properties of EuAgAs single crystals
summary: EuAgAs is an antiferromagnetic topological material exhibiting intriguing magnetic behavior. We investigate its structural, magnetic, and local electronic properties using X ray diffraction, Mössbauer spectroscopy, dc magnetization, ac susceptibility, and heat capacity measurements. The results confirm antiferromagnetic ordering below $T_\text{N}$ and reveal pronounced magnetic anisotropy and several field induced metamagnetic transitions. We construct the magnetic phase diagram of EuAgAs, identifying several distinct magnetic regions. The field and temperature dependent behavior observed suggests a noncollinear magnetic structure in the low field regime. The sequence of field induced transitions resembles that observed in centrosymmetric rare earth compounds hosting skyrmion phases, suggesting that competing magnetic interactions may play an important role in stabilizing the observed magnetic states.

AI.tldr: 本文通过X射线衍射、穆斯堡尔谱、直流磁化、交流磁化率和热容测量，研究了反铁磁拓扑材料EuAgAs的结构、磁性和局域电子性质，构建了其磁相图。
AI.motivation: EuAgAs是一种具有有趣磁行为的反铁磁拓扑材料，需要深入探究其磁性和局域电子性质。
AI.method: 采用X射线衍射、穆斯堡尔谱、直流磁化、交流磁化率和热容测量等多种实验手段。
AI.result: 确认了低于T_N的反铁磁有序，发现显著的磁各向异性和多个场诱导的变磁转变，构建了包含多个不同磁区域的磁相图，低场区可能具有非共线磁结构。
AI.conclusion: 场诱导转变序列类似于具有斯格明子相的中心对称稀土化合物，表明竞争磁相互作用可能在稳定所观察到的磁态中起重要作用。

title: Nonempirical Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory Framework for Nonlocal Exchange--Correlation Potentials
summary: Advanced, orbital-dependent exchange--correlation (XC) functionals can significantly improve the description of electronic structural properties, but they substantially worsen spectral properties that are computed within standard linear-response time-dependent density functional theory frameworks. This is not a failure of the underlying Kohn-Sham states, but due to a formal inconsistency in the treatment of the dynamic density response when the non-locality of the XC potential is not taken into account consistently on the level of the full off-diagonal density matrix. To avoid these complexities, we present a non-empirical additive correction $Δf_\textnormal{xc}(\mathbf{q},ω)$ to the dynamic XC kernel that re-enforces the exact f-sum rule of the non-local KS Hamiltonian within TDDFT. Comparing our new results against a representative set of accurate experimental measurements (ambient aluminum, silicon and carbon, as well as heated and compressed aluminum) reveals a dramatic improvement in all cases without any additional computational cost. The corresponding extension to the open-source GPAW code is made freely available online. We further investigate the implications of non-local pseudopotentials and show that the non-locality has an important, physically motivated effect that is indispensable to capture the correct plasmon dispersion in lieu of full all-electron simulations. In addition to being important for the estimation of a plethora of dynamic and spectral properties, our work constitutes an important step towards a universal XC functional that can be used to estimate all kinds of observables with high accuracy. Finally, we outline the potential utility of our framework for the development of advanced non-local XC functionals, and suggest a new way to rigorously verify non-local pseudopotentials against experimental measurements of collective excitations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对动态交换关联核的非经验加性修正 Δf_xc(q,ω)，在TDDFT中恢复非局域KS哈密顿量的精确f求和规则，显著改善多种材料的谱学性质而不增加计算成本。
AI.motivation: 先进的轨道依赖交换关联泛函能改善电子结构性质，但在标准线性响应TDDFT框架下会显著恶化谱学性质。这并非Kohn-Sham态本身的问题，而是因为未在完整非对角密度矩阵层面一致地考虑XC势的非局域性，导致动态密度响应处理存在形式上的不一致。
AI.method: 提出非经验加性修正 Δf_xc(q,ω) 加入动态XC核，在TDDFT框架内重新强制满足非局域KS哈密顿量的精确f求和规则；扩展至开源GPAW代码，并研究非局域赝势的影响。
AI.result: 与多种精确实验测量对比（常温铝、硅、碳，以及加热压缩铝），所有情况下均获得显著改善且无额外计算成本；非局域赝势具有重要物理效应，对捕捉正确的等离激元色散不可或缺。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为动态和谱学性质估计提供重要工具，是迈向通用高精度XC泛函的重要一步；同时为发展先进非局域XC泛函提供框架，并提出严格验证非局域赝势的新方法。

title: Layer-Dependent Vibrational and Optical Properties of $\mathrm{Mo}{0.58}\mathrm{W}{0.42}\mathrm{Se}_2$ Alloy
summary: Semiconducting Mo$_x$W$_{1-x}$Se$_2$ alloys provide a versatile platform for tailoring the optical properties of two-dimensional materials through both composition and layer thickness. Here, we systematically investigate mechanically exfoliated Mo$_{0.58}$W$_{0.42}$Se$_2$ flakes ranging from monolayer (1L) to nine layers by combining Raman scattering (RS), photoluminescence (PL), reflectance contrast (RC) spectroscopy, and first-principles phonon calculations. Thirteen RS peaks are identified, including the low-frequency interlayer shear mode, whose thickness dependence is well described by a linear-chain model, yielding an interlayer force constant of $K_s=(2.996\pm0.015)\times10^{19}$ N m$^{-3}$. PL measurements reveal a crossover from the direct-bandgap 1L to indirect-bandgap multilayers. The thickness evolution of the indirect optical transition is quantitatively reproduced using a quantum-confinement model, yielding an out-of-plane reduced effective mass of $μ_\perp=0.75 m_0$. RC spectroscopy reveals four excitonic resonances. While the A and B excitons associated with the $K^\pm$ valleys remain nearly independent of layer thickness, the higher-energy C and D resonances originating from the band-nesting regions exhibit pronounced redshifts, reflecting substantial thickness-induced modifications of the electronic band structure. These results establish comprehensive spectroscopic fingerprints of flake thickness, interlayer coupling, and electronic structure in Mo$_x$W$_{1-x}$Se$_2$ alloys and provide a reliable, non-destructive framework for their optical characterization.

AI.tldr: 通过Raman、PL、RC和第一性原理计算系统研究了Mo0.58W0.42Se2合金从单层到九层的厚度依赖光学性质，建立了厚度、层间耦合和电子结构的光谱指纹。
AI.motivation: Mo_xW_{1-x}Se_2合金可通过组分和层厚调控二维材料光学性质，但缺乏系统的厚度依赖光谱研究与非破坏性表征框架。
AI.method: 机械剥离Mo0.58W0.42Se2薄片（1–9层），结合拉曼散射、光致发光、反射对比谱学与第一性原理声子计算。
AI.result: 识别13个RS峰，低频层间剪切模符合线性链模型，层间力常数K_s=(2.996±0.015)×10^19 N m^-3；PL显示1L直接带隙向多层间接带隙转变，量子限域模型给出面外约化有效质量μ_⊥=0.75m0；RC揭示四个激子共振，A/B激子基本不随厚度变化，C/D激子显著红移。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了Mo_xW_{1-x}Se_2合金中厚度、层间耦合与电子结构的光谱指纹，提供可靠的非破坏性光学表征框架。

title: A first introduction to Matrix Product State algorithms for the integration of Lindblad equation
summary: In this introductory review, we present and compare four algorithms for the numerical integration of the Lindblad equation for one-dimensional quantum lattice systems. All four methods are based on Matrix Product State representations and can be viewed as extensions of the Time-Evolving Block Decimation (TEBD) algorithm to open quantum systems. Two approaches directly integrate the vectorized Lindblad equation, one of them explicitly enforcing the positivity of the density matrix. The other two rely on stochastic unravelings of the Lindblad equation, namely the quantum trajectory and quantum state diffusion approaches. We discuss the principles, numerical implementation, accuracy, and computational efficiency of the different methods, and benchmark them against an exactly solvable free fermion model.

AI.tldr: 本文综述并比较了四种基于矩阵乘积态(MPS)的一维量子晶格系统Lindblad方程数值积分算法，包括两种直接积分法(其中一种强制密度矩阵正定性)和两种随机解缠法(量子轨迹与量子态扩散)，并通过可精确求解的自由费米子模型进行基准测试。
AI.motivation: 开放量子系统的一维晶格模拟需要高效数值方法，而现有TEBD等方法需扩展到Lindblad方程场景，各类方法在原理、精度与效率上差异尚需系统比较。
AI.method: 四种基于MPS的方法：(1)矢量化的Lindblad方程直接积分；(2)显式强制密度矩阵正定性的直接积分；(3)量子轨迹随机解缠；(4)量子态扩散随机解缠。通过可精确求解的自由费米子模型进行基准测试。
AI.result: 讨论了各方法的原理、数值实现、精度与计算效率，并在自由费米子模型上进行了量化对比。
AI.conclusion: 提供了四种TEBD扩展算法的系统性综述与比较，为开放量子系统一维晶格模拟的方法选择提供参考。

title: Synthetic twist geometry in mesoscopic quantum circuits: geometric capacitance and chiral mode splitting
summary: We propose a route for encoding a helicoidally twisted synthetic geometry in mesoscopic quantum circuits. A torsionless spatial metric with twist parameter $\Om$ defines an electrostatic capacitance kernel whose angular--axial sector contains the chiral coupling $-2\Om mk$. We show that this kernel can be implemented by a finite, quantizable circuit graph built only from positive two-node capacitors: diagonal bridges generate the cross term, and the dimensionless twist is the ratio of diagonal to total angular capacitance. The resulting capacitance matrix enters the Hamiltonian through $C^{-1}(\etaT)$ and splits counter-rotating synthetic modes. Exact finite-graph diagonalization confirms the analytic spectrum and shows that closed longitudinal circulation is required; with open boundaries the bridge phase is gauge removable and the doublets remain degenerate. Simulated spectroscopy resolves the chiral fan, while disorder simulations indicate that calibrated percent-level reactive disorder does not obscure the deterministic splitting in the parameter range considered. Twist textures produce interface modes, Josephson nonlinearities make the Kerr sector chirality dependent, and the same doublet provides a detuning knob for non-Hermitian exceptional-point control. For representative circuit-QED parameters the splitting is in the tens-of-MHz range, well above typical resonator linewidths.

AI.tldr: 提出用介观量子电路实现螺旋扭曲合成几何，通过电容核仁设计手性耦合，电容矩阵经C⁻¹进入哈密顿量并劈裂反向旋转模式。
AI.motivation: 在量子电路中模拟弯曲/扭曲时空几何的手性效应，尤其是实现可控的手性耦合与模式劈裂。
AI.method: 用仅由正双节点电容构成的有限可量子化电路图实现带扭转参数Ω的电容核仁；对角桥产生交叉项，无量纲扭转=对角与总角向电容之比；通过精确有限图对角化、模拟光谱与无序仿真验证。
AI.result: 解析谱与数值对角化一致；需闭合纵向环流才能实现，开边界下桥相位可规范去除、双峰简并；模拟光谱解析手性扇形；百分级反应性无序不掩盖确定性劈裂；代表电路QED参数下劈裂达数十MHz，远高于典型谐振线宽。
AI.conclusion: 该方案可产生界面模式，约瑟夫森非线性使Kerr扇区手性依赖，双峰可作为非厄米奇异点控制的失谐旋钮。

title: Electronic Origins of Elastic Behavior in Rocksalt, Zinc-Blende and Wurtzite 3d Transition-Metal Nitrides
summary: We present a comprehensive ab-initio study of the elastic properties of the IV-period transition metal nitrides, highlighting the correlation between their mechanical behavior and electronic structure. By analyzing the electronic density of states, we reveal how the occupation of bonding or antibonding orbitals determines the evolution of elastic properties along the period. Furthermore, we examine trends across different crystal structures, specifically comparing rocksalt, zincblende and wurtzite phases, to uncover how variations in crystal symmetry and atomic coordination influence their elastic properties.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理系统研究第四周期过渡金属氮化物的弹性性质，揭示其力学行为与电子结构（键合/反键轨道占据）的关联，并比较岩盐、闪锌矿和纤锌矿三种相的影响。
AI.motivation: 理解过渡金属氮化物弹性性质的演变规律，并建立其与电子结构及晶体结构之间的关联。
AI.method: 采用从头算（ab-initio）方法，分析电子态密度，研究键合与反键轨道占据情况，并对比岩盐、闪锌矿和纤锌矿相。
AI.result: 发现沿周期方向弹性性质的演变由键合/反键轨道占据决定；晶体对称性与原子配位的变化影响弹性性质。
AI.conclusion: 电子结构与晶体结构共同决定第四周期过渡金属氮化物的弹性行为。

title: Current fluctuations of diffusive systems with a battery
summary: For a diffusive system on a ring, with a battery at the origin, we use the macroscopic fluctuation theory (MFT) to obtain the large deviation function of the current. In the case of non-interacting particles, the predictions of the MFT agree with the result of a direct exact microscopic calculation. To our surprise, the large deviation function of non-interacting particles with a battery has the same form as for the Symmetric Simple Exclusion Process (SSEP) with open boundary conditions. For the SSEP on a ring with a battery, the predictions of the MFT seem to agree with the results of long Monte Carlo simulations, although much longer simulations would be needed to better test the validity of these predictions.

AI.tldr: 利用宏观涨落理论(MFT)研究环形扩散系统中带电"电池"时的电流大偏差函数，发现非相互作用粒子的结果与开放边界SSEP形式相同，且MFT对带电SSEP的预测与蒙特卡洛模拟基本一致。
AI.motivation: 研究带"电池"(驱动)的环形扩散系统中电流的涨落统计，检验宏观涨落理论(MFT)在非平衡驱动系统下的有效性，并探索非相互作用粒子与相互作用粒子(SSEP)之间大偏差函数的普适关系。
AI.method: 采用宏观涨落理论(MFT)推导环形系统中位于原点"电池"驱动下电流的大偏差函数；对非相互作用粒子情形与直接微观精确计算进行对比；对带电SSEP情形与长时间蒙特卡洛模拟进行对比验证。
AI.result: 非相互作用粒子情形下，MFT预测与直接微观精确计算一致；且令人意外的是，带电池的非相互作用粒子的大偏差函数与开放边界SSEP具有相同形式。对环形带电SSEP，MFT预测与长时间蒙特卡洛模拟结果似乎吻合，但需更长时间模拟才能更好地检验。
AI.conclusion: MFT能有效描述带电池的环形扩散系统的电流大偏差行为，且揭示了非相互作用粒子与SSEP之间大偏差函数的意外普适性；对相互作用系统的验证仍需更长模拟以确认。

title: Rapid Parameter Estimation from Photoluminescence Decays of Halide Perovskite Thin Films
comment: Main: 49 pages, 10 figures SI: 20 pages, 16 figures
summary: Extracting material parameters from experimental data is often challenging if no invertible analytical equation can be used to link the data with the quantities of interest. If the link between experiment and material parameters is given mathematically by a set of non-linear differential equations, these must be solved repeatedly during the traditional fitting procedure, resulting in long optimization times and limited insight into parameter uncertainty. Here, we present a parameter estimation workflow specifically aimed at transient photoluminescence measurements performed on lead-halide perovskite films. This workflow is accelerated using artificial neural networks for rapid comparison between experiment and simulation. An advantage of the method is the ability to rapidly scan multidimensional material parameter spaces and identify correlations between parameters that provide insights into the physics of non-radiative recombination in halide perovskites. Finally, we compare steady-state and transient photoluminescence and show how uncertainty in parameters such as the defect density can be reduced by including steady-state data in the parameter estimation workflow.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种结合人工神经网络的参数估计工作流，用于快速分析铅卤钙钛矿薄膜的瞬态光致发光数据，以加速参数拟合并揭示非辐射复合物理机制。
AI.motivation: 实验数据与材料参数之间往往由非线性微分方程联系，传统拟合需反复求解这些方程，导致优化耗时长且难以洞察参数不确定性。
AI.method: 构建面向瞬态光致发光测量的参数估计工作流，利用人工神经网络实现实验与模拟的快速比较，从而快速扫描多维材料参数空间。
AI.result: 该方法能快速扫描多维参数空间，识别参数间关联，揭示卤化物钙钛矿非辐射复合物理机制；通过纳入稳态光致发光数据可降低缺陷密度等参数的不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 结合ANN的工作流有效加速了瞬态PL参数估计，并借助稳态数据提升参数可靠性，为理解钙钛矿非辐射复合提供支持。

title: Hierarchy of time scales in kinetically constrained models via stochastic-generator expansion
summary: We revisit the hierarchy of relaxation time scales in stochastic kinetically constrained models (KCMs) obeying detailed balance, using an expansion method developed recently for their quantum counterparts. In the classical setting, we expand the stochastic generator in the low-temperature equilibrium concentration of excitations. As in quantum KCMs, successive truncations of the expansion reveal a nested hierarchy of metastable configurations that remain frozen on progressively longer time scales. Applying the method to the high-to-low temperature quench in the classical one-dimensional East and Fredrickson-Andersen models, we recover the known hierarchy of metastable plateaus and the associated perturbative time scales. We find that the hierarchical time scales are related to the smallest domain lengths. Our results show that the method developed for quantum kinetically constrained models can be used to provide a systematic description of slow relaxation in their classical counterparts as well.

AI.tldr: 本文将量子KCM的低温展开方法推广到经典随机KCM，通过按激发浓度展开随机生成元，系统描述了慢弛豫的层级结构。
AI.motivation: 量子动力学约束模型(KCM)已有低温展开方法可揭示亚稳态层级，但经典KCM的慢弛豫层级缺乏系统描述，作者希望验证该方法能否迁移到经典情况。
AI.method: 对经典KCM的随机生成元按低温平衡激发浓度做微扰展开；逐阶截断得到嵌套的亚稳态构型层级，并将方法应用于一维East模型和Fredrickson-Andersen模型的高温到低温淬火过程。
AI.result: 复现了已知的亚稳态平台层级及相应的微扰时间尺度；发现层级时间尺度与最小畴长度相关。
AI.conclusion: 为量子KCM发展的展开方法同样可用于系统描述其经典对应模型的慢弛豫行为。

title: The role of disconnections in redox-induced phase transformation of metal oxides
comment: 7 pages and 4 figures in the main text; 10 pages and 6 figures in supporting information
summary: Detailed atomic-level understanding of the phase transformation between magnetite (${\rm Fe_3 O_4}$) and haematite (${\rm Fe_2 O_3}$) is lacking, despite widespread interest in redox reactions of metal oxide systems. While the magnetite-to-haematite transformation entails the addition of oxygen to the system and thus a net diffusive flux, haematite formations have been reported to grow along well-defined habits on the close-packed $\{0001\}_{\rm Fe_2 O_3}//\{111\}_{\rm Fe_3 O_4}$ planes. The propagation of the phase interface in the bulk is thus thought to maintain the oxygen sublattice fixed up to a shear, and to require long-range diffusion of iron ions. In this letter we propose interfacial steps with dislocation character, i.e. disconnections, as the elementary defects propagating the transformation. We use the topological model of interfacial defects to predict three disconnection modes for the system, and we employ scanning transmission electron microscopy to ascertain their presence in a haematite/magnetite interface of a partially oxidised magnetite powder. Using atomistic simulations, we determine the equilibrium structures of the disconnections, and study their motion and how they accomplish the transformation, obtaining excellent agreement with atomic-resolution experimental observations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以"错合缺陷(disconnections)"作为磁铁矿向赤铁矿相变的基本传播缺陷，结合拓扑模型预测、STEM观测与原子模拟验证该机制。
AI.motivation: 磁铁矿(Fe3O4)与赤铁矿(Fe2O3)之间的相变在金属氧化物氧化还原反应中广受关注，但其原子尺度机制仍不清楚。相变需向体系加氧并产生净扩散流，然而赤铁矿却沿密排面{0001}Fe2O3//{111}Fe3O4的特定取向生长，说明界面推进时氧亚晶格保持固定（至多发生剪切），而铁离子需长程扩散。作者希望找到能同时解释界面取向、氧亚晶格保持与铁扩散的原子级传播机制。
AI.method: 1) 采用界面缺陷拓扑模型，预测该体系中可能存在的三种错合缺陷(disconnection)模式；2) 使用扫描透射电子显微镜(STEM)在部分氧化的磁铁矿粉末的赤铁矿/磁铁矿界面中确认这些缺陷的存在；3) 通过原子尺度模拟确定错合缺陷的平衡结构，研究其运动方式及其如何完成相变。
AI.result: 拓扑模型预测出三种错合缺陷模式；STEM实验在部分氧化磁铁矿粉末的赤铁矿/磁铁矿界面中证实了这些缺陷的存在；原子模拟给出了错合缺陷的平衡结构及其运动与相变实现方式，且模拟结果与原子分辨率实验观测高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 磁铁矿向赤铁矿的相变可由具有位错特征的界面台阶——即错合缺陷——作为基本传播缺陷来驱动，该机制得到拓扑预测、STEM观测与原子模拟的一致支持。

title: A microscopic heat engine with many hidden variables
summary: Microscopic motors are commonly monitored through a single mechanical coordinate, whereas the chemical, conformational, or rotational cycles that sustain their motion remain unresolved. Mechanical stall is defined by the vanishing of the mean observed velocity; this scalar condition, however, does not generally imply thermodynamic reversibility. We analyze an overdamped Brownian motor in which one observed coordinate is coupled to several internal phases through a single shared interaction potential. Because the transmitted force and the reaction torques derive from the same energy, the resulting rank-one reciprocal structure yields an exact pointwise identity between the observed and hidden probability currents. This identity provides an exact expression for the entropy production at stall for an arbitrary periodic interaction. In particular, a positive current-square dissipation in the mechanical channel, defined from the full stationary state through the coupling-coordinate-resolved local velocity, determines together with the stall load the collective hidden current projected onto the coupling direction. The stationary one-coordinate marginal current nevertheless vanishes identically at stall; consequently, the stationary marginal density and mean displacement current do not determine this dissipation. Hidden currents orthogonal to the coupling direction dissipate without affecting the observed motion and generate an irreducible contribution that cannot be inferred from the rank-one mechanical channel.

AI.tldr: 本文分析欠阻尼布朗马达中单个观测坐标与多个内部相位通过共享势耦合的情形，揭示"机械失速"（平均速度为零）不等价于热力学可逆性，并给出失速时熵产生的精确表达式。
AI.motivation: 微观马达通常仅通过单一机械坐标监测，但维持运动的化学、构象或旋转循环未被解析。机械失速以平均观测速度消失定义，但该标量条件一般不意味着热力学可逆，需要厘清失速状态下隐藏内部循环与熵产生的关系。
AI.method: 研究一个欠阻尼布朗马达，其一个观测坐标通过单一共享相互作用势与多个内部相位耦合。利用传递力与反作用力矩源自同一能量这一事实，得到秩一互易结构，从而建立观测概率流与隐藏概率流之间的精确逐点恒等式。
AI.result: 该恒等式给出任意周期相互作用下失速时熵产生的精确表达式。由稳态通过耦合坐标分辨的局部速度定义机械通道的正电流平方耗散，结合失速负载可确定投影到耦合方向的集体隐藏电流。但稳态单坐标边缘流在失速时恒为零，故边缘密度与平均位移流无法确定该耗散；与耦合方向正交的隐藏电流耗散且产生不可约贡献，无法从秩一机械通道推断。
AI.conclusion: 机械失速并不等同于热力学平衡，隐藏的集体电流仍可存在并耗散。仅凭单一观测坐标的稳态统计量无法推断全部熵产生，因为正交隐藏电流贡献不可约。

title: A Pseudoscalar Representation Mapping from Parent-Group Vibrational Normal Modes to Symmetry-Adapted Magnetic Structures
summary: Conventional approaches classify symmetry-allowed magnetic configurations but do not by themselves establish a direct, mode-resolved correspondence with parent-lattice vibrations. Here, we formulate a universal determinant-induced pseudoscalar twist for all 32 crystallographic point groups, establishing an exact representation-to-geometry correspondence between parent vibrations and magnetic order. Within the paramagnetic gray group $G\timesΘ_{\mathcal{T}}$, the spatial twist determines symmetry-defined magnetic geometry, while time-reversal parity independently specifies magnetic character. Each parent phonon irrep $Γ$ maps to $Γ_{\mathrm{mag}}=Γ\otimesΓ_{\mathrm{ps}}$, preserving multiplicities and yielding the projection identity $P_{\mathrm{mag},mn}^{(Γ\otimesΓ_{\mathrm{ps}})}=P_{\mathrm{ph},mn}^{(Γ)}$ under the common Cartesian realization. This establishes the \textit{Template Principle}: parent vibrational modes furnish real-space templates whose symmetry-enforced nodal manifolds are inherited exactly. Applied to monolayer $\mathrm{Cd}_2\mathrm{N}_3$, the framework identifies the ferrimagnetic ground state from the parent $A_{2u}$ sector, confirmed by first-principles calculations, alongside cluster magnetic octupoles and antiferromagnetic manifolds. It further provides an \textit{a priori} parent-group criterion for screening symmetry-allowed linear magnetic responses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“行列式诱导赝标量扭转”方法，建立全部32个晶体点群中母体振动与磁序之间精确的表示-几何对应关系，并给出“模板原理”。
AI.motivation: 传统方法仅对对称性允许的磁构型进行分类，无法建立与母格振动的直接、模式分辨的对应关系，因此需要一种普适框架将声子模式与磁序几何精确关联。
AI.method: 对全部32个晶体点群构造行列式诱导赝标量扭转；在顺磁灰色群G×Θ_T中，用空间扭转确定对称性定义的磁几何，用时间反演宇称确定磁字符；将母声子不可约表示Γ映射为Γ_mag=Γ⊗Γ_ps，并证明投影恒等式P_mag,mn= P_ph,mn。
AI.result: 该框架保持多重度，并在共同笛卡尔实现下给出投影对应；应用于单层Cd2N3时，从母体A2u扇区识别出亚铁磁基态，经第一性原理计算证实，并发现团簇磁八极和反铁磁流形。
AI.conclusion: 提出“模板原理”：母体振动模式提供实空间模板，其对称性强制的节点流形被精确继承；并为筛选对称性允许的线性磁响应提供先验母群判据。

title: Traveling Waves as Renormalization-Group Fixed Points without Universality Classes
summary: Traveling waves are fundamental asymptotic structures in nonlinear physical systems. While their connection to self-similarity is recognized, their renormalization-group (RG) status remains elusive. We extend a recently developed unified RG framework for nonlinear PDEs to traveling-wave solutions, using Burgers' and KdV equations as paradigmatic examples. By employing a logarithmic transformation, we map traveling waves onto asymptotically self-similar solutions, allowing for a systematic RG treatment. Our analysis reveals a striking departure from the standard RG paradigm: for traveling waves, scale invariance uniquely forces the field's scaling dimension to vanish (A=0). This vanishing dimension implies that the RG transformation rescales space and time while leaving the field magnitude unchanged. Consequently, all analytic perturbations become scale-invariant, eliminating the conventional classification into relevant and irrelevant structures. While classical shock-wave and soliton solutions emerge as stationary RG fixed points, the mechanism for universality class formation - the progressive elimination of irrelevant structures - is fundamentally absent. Traveling waves thus represent a unique class of RG fixed points without universality classes. This finding establishes a crucial distinction between these two concepts and provides a rigorous theoretical basis for why traveling waves exhibit strong memory of initial conditions and system parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展统一的非线性PDE重整化群(RG)框架至行波解,以Burgers和KdV方程为范例,发现行波具有独特的RG地位:标度不变性迫使场的标度维度为零,从而消除了相关/无关结构的传统分类。
AI.motivation: 行波是非线性物理系统的基本渐近结构,虽已知其与自相似性的联系,但其重整化群(RG)地位仍不清楚,本文旨在通过扩展RG框架来厘清行波解的RG性质。
AI.method: 将近期发展的非线性PDE统一RG框架推广到行波解,以Burgers方程和KdV方程为范例,通过对数变换将行波映射为渐近自相似解,从而进行系统的RG处理。
AI.result: 分析表明,行波情形下标度不变性唯一地迫使场的标度维度为零(A=0),这意味着RG变换重整化时空而保持场幅不变,所有解析微扰都变为标度不变的,从而消除了相关与无关结构的传统分类。经典激波与孤立子解作为RG不动点出现,但普适类形成机制(即无关结构的逐步消除)本质上缺失。
AI.conclusion: 行波构成一类独特的RG不动点,却不存在普适类。这一发现明确了两个概念间的关键区别,并为行波表现出对初始条件和系统参数的强记忆性提供了严格的理论基础。

title: Thermally Desorbable InN Capping Layers for Nitride Surface Science
summary: Group III-nitride thin films are essential for optoelectronic and power devices, where surface and interface quality critically influence performance. It is often necessary to transfer these films through atmosphere for processing or characterization steps, which can introduce significant surface contamination. Here we demonstrate a technique to protect the surface of III-N films during atmospheric exposure by capping with sacrificial InN layers. Using molecular beam epitaxy grown AlGaN films as our representative protected material, we take advantage of the lower decomposition and desorption temperatures of InN and metallic In to remove the protective cap layer in situ via thermal desorption without damaging the AlGaN film beneath. Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) measurements of the valence band dispersion in Al0.4Ga0.6N demonstrate that the film surface is recovered after InN decapping, highlighting the versatility of this process in allowing further surface-sensitive characterization of films that had been exposed to air.

AI.tldr: 提出用牺牲性InN覆盖层保护III-N薄膜在空气中免受污染，通过热脱附原位去除，实现AlGaN表面恢复。
AI.motivation: III-N薄膜对光电子和功率器件至关重要，表面/界面质量影响性能，但常需经大气环境传输处理，导致严重表面污染。
AI.method: 用MBE生长的AlGaN为代表性材料，在其上生长牺牲性InN覆盖层；利用InN和金属In较低的分解与脱附温度，通过热脱附原位去除覆盖层。
AI.result: 对Al0.4Ga0.6N价带色散的ARPES测量表明，InN脱附后薄膜表面得以恢复，且未损伤下方AlGaN。
AI.conclusion: 该技术在空气中保护III-N薄膜并可原位脱附，允许对曾暴露于空气的薄膜进行后续表面敏感表征，具有通用性。

title: Field-driven quantum phase transitions in a spin-1/2 Heisenberg antiferromagnet on an extended Lieb lattice
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, presented at Physics of Magnetism conference
summary: The magnetic behavior of the spin-1/2 Heisenberg antiferromagnet on the extended Lieb lattice is examined in the presence of an external magnetic field. Using density matrix renormalization group calculations, we determine the zero-temperature magnetization curves and construct the ground-state phase diagram in the magnetic field vs. the interaction ratio plane. Depending on the interaction ratio, the zero-temperature magnetization curves exhibit field-driven quantum phase transitions between the gapped phases manifested as the intermediate plateaus at $1/5$ and $3/5$ of the saturation magnetization and a gapless spin-canted phase, in which the magnetization varies continuously with the applied magnetic field. Quantum Monte Carlo simulations reveal clear finite-temperatures signatures of the field-induced quantum phase transitions and the intermediate magnetization plateaus, while they provide no evidence for either continuous or discontinuous thermal phase transitions.

AI.tldr: 研究扩展Lieb晶格上自旋1/2海森堡反铁磁体在磁场下的磁性，用DMRG确定磁化曲线与基态相图，发现1/5和3/5磁化平台及自旋倾斜无隙相。
AI.motivation: 探究扩展Lieb晶格这一几何阻挫体系在磁场诱导下可能出现的量子相变与中间磁化平台行为。
AI.method: 采用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）计算零温磁化曲线并构建磁场-相互作用比相图；用量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）模拟有限温性质。
AI.result: 磁化曲线显示场驱动量子相变，出现饱和磁化1/5与3/5的中间平台，以及磁化随磁场连续变化的自旋倾斜无隙相；QMC显示有限温下这些相变与平台的清晰特征，但无连续或非连续热相变证据。
AI.conclusion: 扩展Lieb晶格海森堡反铁磁体具有丰富的磁场诱导量子相，中间平台与无隙相由相互作用比控制，且有限温无热相变迹象。

title: ERAF4XRD: A multimodal agentic framework for constructing validated experimental X-ray diffraction databases from scientific literature
summary: The scientific literature contains decades of experimental measurements that remain difficult to access as structured data for modern AI and data-driven research. Much of this information is distributed across figures, captions, text, and tables, requiring experimental data and their context to be identified, connected, and verified before they can be reused. Here we introduce ERAF4XRD (Experiment Reader Agentic Framework for X-Ray Diffraction), a fully automated multimodal (i.e., image and text), multi-agent framework that reconstructs validated X-ray diffraction (XRD) records from scientific publications. ERAF4XRD downloads and screens documents, identifies XRD figures, extracts and links metadata to the corresponding experimental data, and validates outputs against source evidence using an independent validation agent. On a manually curated benchmark of 273 scientific publications containing 3,150 candidate figures, ERAF4XRD achieved up to 98.7% accuracy for XRD figure identification and generated 1,400 metadata values across 22 fields. Independent manual assessment of the final validated records yielded 98.5% precision and 90.7% recall, with no unsupported metadata observed among 443 evaluated fields. By moving beyond information extraction to the reconstruction and validation of linked experimental records, ERAF4XRD establishes an automated approach for transforming published scientific information into machine-readable experimental datasets for AI and data-driven science.

AI.tldr: ERAF4XRD：全自动多模态多智能体框架，从科学文献重建并验证XRD实验记录。
AI.motivation: 数十年的实验测量数据分散在图表、说明、正文和表格中，难以作为结构化数据供现代AI与数据驱动研究使用，需先识别、关联并验证实验数据及其上下文。
AI.method: 提出ERAF4XRD框架：下载筛选文献、识别XRD图、抽取并关联元数据与实验数据，并通过独立验证智能体对输出进行验证。
AI.result: 在273篇文献、3150个候选图的人工基准上，XRD图识别准确率达98.7%；在22个字段生成1400个元数据值；最终记录的精度98.5%、召回率90.7%，443个评估字段中无无支撑元数据。
AI.conclusion: ERAF4XRD超越信息抽取，实现关联实验记录的自动化重建与验证，为AI与数据驱动科学构建机器可读实验数据集。

title: Hypothesis-Driven Autonomous Materials Synthesis with Multimodal LLM Agents
summary: Self-driving laboratories can explore synthesis conditions autonomously, but their decision-making layer is typically a black-box optimizer, and the output is a set of optimized samples, with the measurements reduced to predefined scalar objectives and the reasons behind success left unarticulated. Here we present SynAgent, a framework in which large language model agents operate an automated experimental system and maintain an explicit, revisable understanding of the synthesis process as the campaign's primary output. Starting with no predefined analysis pipeline, SynAgent adaptively generates analysis skills for newly acquired data and evolves this understanding through multimodal reasoning over experimental data such as X-ray diffraction patterns and electron micrographs. The evolution is guided by a verify-falsify scheme, in which the agent deliberately challenges its own hypotheses by testing conditions predicted to fail as well as those predicted to succeed. In a single campaign of 18 autonomous experiments using LiCoO2 (001) thin-film deposition as a testbed, SynAgent synthesized highly crystalline films and evolved an understanding of how the substrate temperature governs crystallization, discovering an abrupt threshold and a narrow optimal growth window at 650-690 °C. These results extend autonomous experimentation beyond optimized samples to testable, human-readable understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出SynAgent框架，用LLM智能体操作自动化实验系统，将可修改的合成过程理解作为核心输出，而非仅仅优化样品。
AI.motivation: 自驱动实验室的决策层通常是黑箱优化器，只输出优化样品，测量结果被简化为预设标量目标，成功原因未被阐述。
AI.method: LLM智能体操作自动化实验系统；无需预设分析流程，自适应生成分析技能，通过多模态推理（XRD、电镜）演化理解；采用"验证-证伪"机制，主动测试预测失败与成功的条件。
AI.result: 在LiCoO2(001)薄膜沉积18次自主实验中合成高结晶薄膜，揭示衬底温度对结晶的控制作用，发现650-690°C的突变阈值与狭窄最优生长窗口。
AI.conclusion: 将自主实验从优化样品扩展到可测试、人类可读的科学理解。

title: Low Temperature Halide Assisted HVPE Growth of Single Crystal AlN Films
comment: 7 pages, 6 figures, to be submitted to Journal of Crystal Growth
summary: Low defect, single polarity aluminum nitride layers grown by halide vapor phase epitaxy (HVPE) methods have classically needed growth temperatures well exceeding 1100°C with many of the best results being grown in the range of 1400°C. These high temperatures have typically been required to obtain Al-polar AlN films with smooth morphologies and high crystalline quality. However, these elevated temperatures make the use of quartz reactor chambers difficult, as quartz begins to soften at 1200°C, and requires specially designed reactors. This study examines the use of anhydrous hydrogen chloride (HCl) gas, injected directly to the growth surface, to suppress inverted polarity grains that form at low growth temperatures. This method allows for high quality, single crystal AlN layers with a growth temperature of just 1000°C in a quartz reactor chamber. With this method, AlN layers of 5 um thickness were grown on c-plane (0 0 0 1) sapphire, with a growth rate of 20 um/hour, and a resulting full-width at half-maximum (FWHM) of symmetric (0 0 0 2) rocking curve reflection under 400 arcsec and asymmetric (1 0 -1 2) reflection under 1000 arcsec. Electron backscatter diffraction measurements showed the suppression of inversion domains with increasing free HCl, resulting in smoother and higher quality films.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出在HVPE生长AlN时直接向生长表面注入无水HCl气体，可在1000°C低温、石英反应腔内抑制反转极性晶粒，获得高质量单极性AlN薄膜。
AI.motivation: 传统HVPE生长高质量单极性AlN需超过1100°C（最佳约1400°C）的高温，但高温使石英反应腔难用（石英1200°C软化），需要特殊反应器。因此需要一种低温下仍能获得高质量Al极性AlN的方法。
AI.method: 在HVPE过程中向生长表面直接注入无水HCl气体，以抑制低温生长时形成的反转极性晶粒；在石英反应腔内于1000°C下在c面(0001)蓝宝石衬底上生长AlN。
AI.result: 生长出5 µm厚AlN薄膜，生长速率20 µm/h；对称(0002)摇摆曲线FWHM低于400 arcsec，非对称(10-12)反射低于1000 arcsec；EBSD显示随自由HCl增加反转畴被抑制，薄膜更平滑、质量更高。
AI.conclusion: 直接注入HCl可在1000°C低温下抑制反转极性畴，实现石英反应腔内高质量单晶AlN生长，降低了对超高温反应器的依赖。

title: Adaptive Substrate Support Based on Thin-Film Piezoelectric Actuators
summary: Advanced lithography scanners require extreme substrate flatness in the range of nanometers to prevent focus errors. Such a flatness is challenging to reach and maintain using static substrate supports. Active correction concepts using bulk piezoelectric or linear actuators become prohibitive due to wiring and volume limitations, considering the thousands of pillars required. In this work, we present to our knowledge the first ever demonstration of an active substrate support concept based on thin-film piezoelectric actuators. The working principle, fabrication steps, and characterization of a proof-of-principle device, supported by finite element modeling (FEM), are presented in detail. The fabricated device shows a displacement above 9 nm, which is sufficient to correct some of the focus errors in lithography systems. We foresee that this new concept may open the way towards smaller chip dimensions and improved yield.

AI.tldr: 本文首次展示基于薄膜压电执行器的主动基底支撑概念，用于光刻扫描仪的纳米级平坦度校正，原型器件位移超过9 nm。
AI.motivation: 光刻扫描仪需纳米级基底平坦度以避免聚焦误差，静态支撑难以达到和维持，而传统块体压电或线性执行器因布线庞大、体积受限，在需数千支柱的情况下不可行。
AI.method: 提出基于薄膜压电执行器的主动基底支撑概念，详细阐述工作原理、制造步骤与原型器件表征，并用有限元建模(FEM)加以支持。
AI.result: 所制造器件实现超过9 nm的位移，足以校正光刻系统中的部分聚焦误差。
AI.conclusion: 该新概念有望推动更小芯片尺寸和更高良率的实现。

title: Photoresponse properties of single-crystalline thick film based on high-entropy topological insulator (Bi3/4Sb1/4)2(Te2/5Se2/5S1/5)3
summary: High-entropy topological insulator (Bi3/4Sb1/4)2(Te2/5Se2/5S1/5)3 has been for the first time prepared by self-propagating high-temperature synthesis and melting methods. Single-crystalline thick-filmed sample with thickness of ~0.1 mm was applied to examine the photoresponse properties by using room-temperature chopped-light technique. Photodetector based on (Bi3/4Sb1/4)2(Te2/5Se2/5S1/5)3 demonstrated strong photovoltaic response under irradiation of a white LED light, covering 420-730 nm range. The photocurrent increases from ~20 to ~55 mkA with the increase in intensity from 100 to 600 W/m2 that is originated from the increase in the number of non-equilibrium carriers generated by light. Room-temperature responsivity and detectivity of the photodetector are ~8.7 mA/W and ~109 Jones, respectively.

AI.tldr: 首次用自蔓延高温合成与熔融法制备高熵拓扑绝缘体(Bi3/4Sb1/4)2(Te2/5Se2/5S1/5)3，并制成光电探测器，在白光LED下展现强光伏响应，室温响应度~8.7 mA/W、探测率~10⁹ Jones。
AI.motivation: 探索高熵拓扑绝缘体的制备及其光电响应特性，开发新型室温光电探测器材料。
AI.method: 采用自蔓延高温合成法和熔融法制备该高熵拓扑绝缘体；用约0.1 mm厚的单晶厚膜样品，通过室温斩波光技术表征光响应。
AI.result: 在420-730 nm白光LED照射下表现出强光伏响应；光电流随光照强度从100增至600 W/m²由~20升至~55 µA；室温响应度~8.7 mA/W，探测率~10⁹ Jones。
AI.conclusion: 该高熵拓扑绝缘体可作为一种有前景的室温光电探测材料。

title: Gauge-including neural-network quantum Monte Carlo for molecules in magnetic fields
summary: External magnetic fields, through their coupling to orbital and spin motion, complicate the correlated electronic states and impose coordinate-dependent phases on the wavefunction, thereby making accurate electronic structure calculations substantially more demanding. Recently, neural network-based quantum Monte Carlo (NNQMC) has emerged as a highly accurate approach to study nucleus-free systems in magnetic fields. For molecular systems, however, things get more complicated as the magnetic field would introduce a rapidly varying phase in the region far from the gauge origin. Here we introduce a gauge-including phase factor that acts directly on the full many-electron wavefunction and accounts for the prescribed magnetic phase, leaving a smoother correlated residual for the network to learn. This factor greatly improves molecular translation consistency and size consistency, providing a route for studying systems in magnetic fields with NNQMC. Upon this approach, we reproduce weak-field magnetizabilities and strong-field bond contraction in \ce{H2}. We further apply the method to selected transitions in the \ce{CN} red and \ce{C2} Swan systems at magnetic fields relevant to white dwarfs. The \ce{CN} transition exhibits a much larger field-induced shift than its \ce{C2} counterpart, suggesting its potential as a probe of white-dwarf magnetic fields.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种引入规范相因子的神经网络量子蒙特卡洛方法，用于磁场下分子电子结构的高精度计算，并应用于白矮星磁场相关体系。
AI.motivation: 磁场通过耦合轨道和自旋运动使关联电子态复杂化，并给波函数带来坐标依赖的相位，导致电子结构计算困难。神经网络量子蒙特卡洛虽已用于无核体系，但分子体系因远离规范原点处磁场引入快速变化的相位而更加复杂。
AI.method: 引入一个直接作用于全多电子波函数的规范相因子，用来精确描述给定磁场相位，使网络只需学习更平滑的关联残差。
AI.result: 该方法显著改善了分子平移一致性和尺寸一致性；复现了H2的弱场磁化率和强场键收缩；应用于白矮星磁场下的CN red和C2 Swan跃迁，CN跃迁表现出远大于C2的场致位移。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为NNQMC研究磁场下分子体系提供了可行途径，并表明CN跃迁可能作为探测白矮星磁场的探针。

title: Epitaxial inversion of spontaneous polarization in ε-Ga2O3
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures in manuscript, 3 figures in SI
summary: Polar wide bandgap semiconductors offer the unique capability to manipulate internal electric fields and induce two-dimensional electron gases (2DEG). The emerging orthorhombic ε-Ga2O3 is a promising candidate owing to its large spontaneous polarization (Psp). However, exploiting this material is hindered by fundamental ambiguities surrounding its absolute Psp vectors and the inability to govern its epitaxial direction. Here we show the resolution of the absolute Psp vectors in ε-Ga2O3 and control of its macroscopic polarity via substrate engineering. By correlating interferometric piezoresponse with atomic configurations, we establish an identification criterion where opposing polarities are assigned through the geometric elevation within an asymmetric four-atom sequence. Guided by this signature, we demonstrate that epitaxy on Al-polar AlN and sapphire yields uniformly Ga-polar (upward Psp) and O-polar (downward Psp) architectures, respectively, whereas deteriorated crystallinity disrupts this registry and triggers mixed-polarity. This atomic-to-macroscopic correlation eliminates long-standing ambiguities regarding absolute polar orientations in non-centrosymmetric oxides. Analogous to mature III-Nitride architectures, this blueprint provides the foundational platform for designing macroscopic polarization discontinuities at heterointerfaces, unlocking ε-Ga2O3 for advanced polarization electronics.

AI.tldr: 本文解决了正交ε-Ga2O3绝对自发极化(Psp)矢量模糊问题，并通过衬底工程控制其宏观极性。
AI.motivation: 极性宽带隙半导体能调控内建电场并诱导2DEG，ε-Ga2O3因大Psp成为潜力材料，但其绝对Psp矢量方向存在根本模糊，且外延方向难以操控，阻碍了应用。
AI.method: 将干涉压电响应与原子构型关联，基于不对称四原子序列中的几何高度建立极性识别判据；在Al极性AlN和蓝宝石衬底上进行外延。
AI.result: 在Al极性AlN上获得均匀Ga极性(向上Psp)，在蓝宝石上获得O极性(向下Psp)；结晶质量恶化会破坏这种规律并引发混合极性。
AI.conclusion: 该原子到宏观的关联消除了非中心对称氧化物绝对极性取向的长期模糊，为ε-Ga2O3先进极化电子学提供基础平台，可设计异质界面的宏观极化不连续。

title: Effect of independent parameters on nanoparticle sizes in magnetron-sputtering inert-gas condensation
comment: Main manuscript: 21 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Supplementary Information: 14 pages, 3 figures, 1 table
summary: Magnetron-sputtering inert-gas condensation (MS-IGC) provides a scalable, environmentally friendly vapour-phase synthesis approach for preparing customised nanoparticles (NPs) with bespoke properties via fine-tuning several deposition parameters. However, this high-level control comes with a caveat: the synthesis mechanisms are affected by deposition parameters in complicated ways, often yielding unpredictable outputs. This report details the working mechanism of a typical MS-IGC system, achieving in situ synthesis, size screening, and directional deposition of nanoclusters through the synergistic operation of the three vacuum chambers (condensation, screening, and deposition). The study systematically explores the regulation laws of multiple key process parameters (e.g., inert-gas flows, aggregation length, etc.) on the formation, size distribution, and deposition behaviour of nanoclusters, to rationalise their chosen values toward optimised output. To this end, multiple linear regression analysis was performed to isolate the effect of each deposition parameter and thus quantify its effect on the NP size and size distribution. Our results indicate that parameters that may prolong the nascent NPs' residence inside the condensation chamber (most prominently, the exit nozzle diameter) can positively affect the final NP size. This study expands the understanding of NP formation, enabling improved experimental control and process optimisation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究磁控溅射惰性气体凝聚(MS-IGC)系统中多参数对纳米颗粒尺寸及分布的调控规律，利用多元线性回归量化各参数影响。
AI.motivation: MS-IGC可规模化、环保地制备定制纳米颗粒，但沉积参数以复杂方式影响合成机制，导致产物难以预测，需理清调控规律。
AI.method: 详述典型MS-IGC系统工作机制，通过凝聚腔、筛选腔、沉积腔三腔协同实现原位合成、尺寸筛选与定向沉积；系统探究惰性气体流量、聚集长度等关键参数对纳米团簇形成、尺寸分布与沉积行为的影响，并采用多元线性回归分离各参数效应。
AI.result: 延长新生纳米颗粒在凝聚腔内停留时间的参数（尤以出口喷嘴直径最为显著）会对最终纳米颗粒尺寸产生正向影响。
AI.conclusion: 该研究深化了对纳米颗粒形成机制的理解，有助于改进实验控制与工艺优化。

title: An Atlas and Design Rules for Single- and Dual-Atom Alloys
summary: A long-standing goal across heterogeneous catalysis, materials science, and condensed matter physics is to design alloys with prescribed local atomic arrangements. Recent experiments show that dilute trimetallic alloys unlock chemistries inaccessible to bimetallics, but realizing this potential requires knowing which dopant structures form across an enormous compositional space. Using density functional theory screening, we construct an atlas spanning transition metal single- and dual-atom alloys in Cu and Ag surfaces, which we validate by scanning tunneling microscopy. The stability follows an electron count: dopants pair most strongly when their combined d-electron count approaches ten. Host metal and surface facet can be used to tune the resulting active site motifs, while size mismatch and spin explain variations around this trend. We further introduce a reactor-anchor concept, in which one dopant anchors a second, otherwise bulk-segregating dopant at the surface. Together, these results establish design principles for engineering alloys with targeted active site structures.

title: Divergence between long- and short-wavelength magnon damping in spinel ferrites
summary: The realization of practical, high-speed magnonic devices requires engineering magnetic materials with low dissipation over wide frequency ranges. While optical and microwave probes are used to infer the damping of low energy/long wavelength modes, the degree to which these $q\sim0$ properties translate into higher-energy, finite-momentum modes remains an important open question. Here, we utilize a combination of ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) and resonant inelastic x-ray scattering on spinel ferrites Li$_{0.5}$Al$_x$Fe$_{2.5-x}$O$_4$ to probe magnons in both the short- and long-wavelength limits. We observe that aluminum substitution both markedly reduces the magnon bandwidth and drastically shortens the high-$q$ magnon lifetimes, in sharp contrast to the ultralow magnon damping inferred from FMR. These findings demonstrate a disparity between how non-magnetic substituents impact magnon damping in the long- and short-wavelength limits, providing a new perspective for assessing candidate materials for magnonic devices.
